summary: Round 1 had no findings. Since then only a static lint regex (non-normalized path segments '/./', '//', 'name/..') in tools/lint/headless-boundary.js and fixed-string test probes changed. The regex is developer config applied to import specifiers in repo source; there is no untrusted input. It has no nested quantifiers, so ReDoS is not a concern. The change closes a lint bypass of the REQ-025.1 bot fairness boundary. No new dependencies, no secrets, no runtime change. No findings.
